# Catppuccin tmux

Configuration files from the installed Catppuccin tmux v2.3.1 theme.
Upstream: https://github.com/catppuccin/tmux/tree/v2.3.1

Vendored without modifications, with the upstream MIT license. This keeps
dalftui installation offline and preserves the current pane/message/copy-mode
appearance. The custom rounded tabs are defined in ../../config/tmux.conf.
